segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey, do you have five on the Northstar renewal? They want to add 18 seats and push the services start to May 6.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, so I looked at the quote. Current term ends April 30, right? If we co-term the new seats, it’s $14,760 net for the remainder.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That matches my math. Procurement asked if we can keep the same payment terms, net 30, annual invoice.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: That’s fine. No pricing issue from my side. Did they accept the 3% uplift on the base renewal?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They did. The only thing holding it is the data processing language. I’ve nudged legal and the security team a few times for the sign-off, and Northstar won’t release the PO until that answer comes back.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. If it lands today, can they still sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, their controller said Friday noon Eastern is their cutoff for the April invoice batch.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Good. For the services piece, keep the kickoff as May 6, but put the admin training on May 9. Their ops lead is out that first week.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Got it. I’ll send the updated order form with 126 total seats and the May dates once the language is cleared.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Perfect. And don’t discount the add-on any further. They’re already at 12% blended.
